relics.name: Endless Harvest
relics.desc: Grants the ability to gather items directly to your bank.

effects.desc: All resources gathered from Archaeology, Farming, Fishing, Mining, and Woodcutting are automatically sent to your bank, metal bank, or archaeology storage.
When Fishing, Mining, or Woodcutting there's a 10% chance for the resource to be upgraded to the next tier.
You never fell standard trees, unless someone else fells it.
If a fishing spot moves you will follow it and continue gathering. If a tree is felled you will wait for it to regrow before continuing to gather from it.
Mining stamina is always 100%.
Archaeology time sprites do not move and instead follow you.

relics.name: Golden Touch
relics.desc: Grants a pair of boots that ensure a surefooted approach to Agility while also improving your Thieving proficiency. These can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Goldenhawk boots grant you Agility XP periodically while running, skilling, or using ultimate abilities.
Gain golden feathers when gaining XP in Agility or Thieving. These can be alchemised for 50,000 coins or offered for Prayer XP.
Upon completing an agility course lap, receive 10,000 coins per Agility level.
Upon completing an agility course lap, the Agility XP for completing the lap is +200%.
Prevents you from failing agility course obstacles and shortcuts.
Never fail a Thieving check.
All Thieving loot is noted.
Stealing from stalls and chests does not cause them to deplete.
You automatically keep thieving when stealing from stalls and chests.
Safes no longer have a cooldown after being cracked.
Receive triple loot from pickpocketing, chests and stalls (except coins).
Coins gained from Thieving are multiplied by 100x.
When looting chests or safes, you have a chance to obtain a bundle of herbs or potion ingredients sent directly to your bank.

relics.name: Survivalist
relics.desc: Grants the Survivalist's Bag, which can store 100 each of any 3 logs, raw fish, or ore. Also grants the Pickaxe of the Faithful, the Hatchet of Devotion, and the Harpoon of the Pious, which act as the highest tier tool for Mining, Woodcutting, and Fishing, respectively. These tools can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Resources are doubled while Fishing, Mining, Woodcutting or excavating Archaeology hotspots.
Rockertunities and Critical Swings deal double damage.
Rockertunities immediately award an ore.
Sprite Focus gain is doubled.
Whenever you discover an artefact or lore page, you immediately gain 100% Sprite Focus.
Discovered artefacts have a 50% chance to be immediately restored, and gain the XP for the restoration.

tierPassives.desc: All Farming crops grow 5x faster.
Run energy never drains.
Archaeology shop is fully available.
Archaeology Chronote gain is 5x higher.
Souls earned from Necromancy rituals are increased by +400%.
Boss instance respawn timers are faster.

unlockNotes: The Invention tutorial is auto-completed. When unlocked, your Invention skill will be set to level 5.

relics.name: Animal Wrangler
relics.desc: Grants benefits to Hunter, Fishing and livestock Farming.

effects.desc: Bank fish automatically when fishing, and hunter loot when hunting.
When gaining a bonus baby animal from this relic, you can receive an Anachronia farm animal instead.
When capturing Hunter creatures or Fishing, there's a 2% chance to have a random farm animal sent to your bank.
When catching fish, capturing Hunter creatures, or harvesting farm animals, there is a 33% chance to obtain random clean herbs, wood spirits or herb, tree or fruit tree seed sent to your bank.
Hunter catch chance is 100%.
Hunter loot is increased 5x.
Hunter marks are increased 5x.
Spirit moths give you 10x as many charms.
Anachronia and Havenhythe Big Game Hunter creatures no longer require bait.
Anachronia and Havenhythe Big Game Hunter creatures are twice as slow to catch you.
Hunter traps attract creatures faster.
Fishing no longer requires bait.
Always catch an additional fish.
Farm animals always have 100% stats.
Farm animals never get hungry.
Buyers always pay the highest amount of beans for sold animals, regardless of age or disease.
Farm animals are 20x more common from their sources.

relics.name: Superheated
relics.desc: Cooking things, burning things, and smithing things, keeping you heated the whole way through.

effects.desc: Burn logs automatically when woodcutting, without the required Firemaking level.
Automatically cook fish caught with fishing, without the required Cooking level.
Logs are added to bonfires at a rate of 0.6 seconds per log.
Lighting just one incense stick will provide max potency for 60 minutes.
Fire Spirits are replaced with a Blessed Fire Spirit and spawn more frequently.
When smelting ores, you always gain double the bars. There is a 3% chance to gain a bonus 50 bars.
When smelting ores, smelt bars up to 60 times instead of 28.
Always have max heat when Smithing.
Triple base progress per strike when Smithing.
Completing in-progress Smithing items will award the Invention materials the item would have yielded if disassembled.
Completing Ceremonial Sword Plans gives x5 Smithing XP and 50 bars of the metal you were using.
XP for Burial Sets is increased by 3x.
Blessed Fire Spirits can spawn while Smithing.

relics.name: Divine Druid
relics.desc: Grants Thera's Summoning Pouch, a pouch that stores grimy herbs and charms, acts as infinite spirit shard and summoning pouches, as well as other Summoning, Herblore and Divination benefits. This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Cleaning grimy herbs turns them directly into unfinished potions.
Grimy Herbs and Charms can be found frequently when Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing, Siphoning or excavating Archaeology hotspots.
Grimy herbs are all cleaned at once.
Gain a 75% chance to save some ingredients when creating potions.
All charms dropped from defeating enemies are increased by 5x.
Summoning familiars which boost skills now boost them by x3 the amount.
50% chance to create an extra pouch per pouch created, sent directly to the bank.
When crafting pouches, you will also make 10 of the respective familiar's scroll, sent directly to the bank. No extra XP will be awarded.
Always gather Enriched memories.
Memory strands are gained at 10x rate.
Chronicle Fragments give 2x XP (before any League multipliers).
Converting energies and memories together only requires half as many energies, rounded down.
Converting memories has a 10% chance to give a random porter or divine charge, sent directly to the bank.
Crafting items from divine energies only requires half as many energies, rounded down.

tierPassives.desc: Earn 10x more Thaler.
Rare items are twice as common.
Slayer points and Reaper points are 5x when completing tasks.
All reputation gain is increased by +400%.
Archaeology lore drops are 30% more common.

relics.name: Nature's Network
relics.desc: Provides the perfect magical support for any avid farmers.

effects.desc: Grants a Fairy mushroom, which allows you to teleport to any fairy ring, spirit tree or farming patch. This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.
Patches are harvested instantly and produce is automatically noted.
Seeds planted instantly grow to full.
All patches are always treated with ultracompost.
25% chance to save planted seeds when sowing.
Herb seeds are planted at max amount, with only the base amount of seeds used.

relics.name: Assassin's Insight
relics.desc: Provides a teleport to all major Slayer targets and Slayer Masters.

effects.desc: Grants a Skull of Slaying, which allows you to teleport to any Slayer Master and a range of slayer dungeons and monsters. This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.
When assigned a Slayer task, you will be able to choose between two tasks.
Choose between minimum or maximum assignment amounts when choosing a new Slayer task.
Monsters can be added to the Prefer and Block lists for free.
Elite Slayer monsters are 5x more likely to spawn.
Elite Slayer monsters give 5x Slayer XP when defeated (before any League modifiers).
You have the effects of the Corrupted Slayer Mask without needing to wear it.
Monsters are captured into Ushabtis 100% of the time.

relics.name: Voidwalker
relics.desc: Weave through the abyss with the teleports of a range of jewellery combined into one. It can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Grants an Abyssal Conduit, a powerful item that provides unlimited teleports from the following jewellery pieces:

tierPassives.desc: Unlock all skillcape passive perks (except defence) for skills you have 99 in.
10% chance when defeating monsters to receive a mixture of Common and Uncommon Invention materials. Total of 8 materials per go.
3x Dungeoneering token gain.

relics.name: Crystal Grace
relics.desc: Grants you Seren's Crystal Tiara, which acts as an Omni-tiara for entering all runecrafting altars and offers teleports to runecrafting altars in your unlocked regions. The Tiara also acts as a Demonhorn necklace when worn or in the inventory. It can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Unlocks all magic Spells.
When gaining XP in any skill: 50% chance to obtain a Crystal Essence, which can be used in place of pure or impure essence.
Rune quantity output from essence, including Crystal Essence, is increased 3x.
Level-based rune multipliers are always the maximum regardless of your Runecrafting level.

Necromancy rituals act as having the following glyphs effects active without needing to draw them:
Multiply - 200%
Attraction - 200%
Protection - 200%
Speed - 50%
Light Sources and Glyphs no longer require ingredients.
When burying a bone or offering it at an altar, you will gain additional XP equivalent to a Dragon bone (before any League modifiers).

relics.name: Transmutation
relics.desc: Grants the Deities' Transmuter. This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Alchemical spells transmute items.
Transmutation spells bank noted products.

relics.name: Antiquarian
relics.desc: Grants benefits to Archaeology.

effects.desc: All Archaeology relics are available to use after completing the Archaeology tutorial.
Archaeology materials are automatically sent to the material storage, or to the bank if it's full.
The Monolith provides 1,000 Monolith Energy.
Receive 10x as many chronotes from handing in collections (overwrites the passive 5x multiplier).
Restoring an artefact costs half as many materials.
Archaeology journal acts as a free soil screener.
An Ancient Casket is received when completing an Archaeology collection.
Whenever you discover an artefact or lore page, you immediately gain 100% Sprite Focus.
Fixate is available straight away, and no longer has a cap to casting.
Archaeology lore pages are 20% more common (in addition to the passive 30% increase).
Divine Geodes can be found while Excavating and contain Archaeology materials.

tierPassives.desc: Rare items are 4x more common.
20% chance when defeating monsters to receive a mixture of Common and Uncommon Invention materials. Total of 12 materials per go.
Bosses no longer require kill count or keys to access.

unlockNotes: Unlock all items on the toolbelt.

relics.name: Clue Connoisseur
relics.desc: Grants you Uri's Briefcase, which can store sealed clue scrolls and caskets and allows you to teleport to any hidey-holes available in your unlocked areas. It can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Unlock the Globetrotter's outfit.
3x Treasure Trail points from completing clues.
Globetrotter's outfit gains 3x charges per completed clue.
Receive an extra casket when completing clues.
When starting a new clue it will have the minimum number of steps to complete.
When opening treasure caskets you will receive the maximum number of loot drops.
All hidey-holes act as being full for the Globetrotter outfit effect.
2x chance of receiving a sealed clue scroll.
Can find an unlimited amount of sealed clues.

relics.name: Production Master
relics.desc: Grants the Brooch of the Spirits. This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Various production activities will have their items processed at once.
Never accidentally burn food.
Your Brooch of the Spirits supplies infinite urns.
When wearing your Brooch of the Spirits, you will gain portable skilling station benefits, even when not using one.
When wearing your Brooch of the Spirits, you can spawn Seren spirits, Divine blessings, Catalysts of Alteration, and Manifested Knowledge.
Where applicable, Masterwork items now take 1 action to complete.

relics.name: Devout
relics.desc:
Grants a Devout Yak pouch and the Ethereal Storage scroll.
- The Devout Yak is a summoning familiar with 32 inventory slots. It can access the bank from anywhere and change items to/from notes.
- The Ethereal Storage scroll can be used to repeat the last unnote action, using the last noted item and amount.
The scroll and pouch are never consumed and do not require Summoning points. They can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Familiars which give you stat boosts also give 10 XP in the respective skill when gaining XP, up to every 6 seconds.
Summoning scrolls are no longer consumed when used.
Familiar spell point costs are reduced to 10% of their original value.
Familiars deal more damage based on your Summoning level, up to +500% damage at 99 Summoning.

tierPassives.desc: Rare items are 6x more common.
You can swap between unlocked spell and prayer books at The Sage.
When getting assigned a Soul Reaper task from Death, you will be able to choose which task you want.
20% chance when defeating monsters to receive a mixture of Common and Uncommon Invention materials. Total of 20 materials per go.
Augmented items gain experience 4x faster.
5x Dungeoneering token gain.

relics.name: Perkfection
relics.desc:
Grants the Inventor's Toolbox, which acts as an XP Capacitor but can store 10x max charges and charges up 10x faster. It also has two gizmo slots which are applied in addition to any equipped perks. You must be using an augmented item for these perks to activate. These can be swapped out freely. The toolbox allows you to teleport to any Inventor's workbenches available in your unlocked areas.
This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: When disassembling items, your junk chance is reduced to 0%.
Obtain 10x Invention materials when disassembling items.
Augmented items and machines consume no charge.
The capacity of machines is increased by 10x.
Invention machines run 10x faster.
The Invention requirement to build machines is reduced to level 1.
Helpful perks will trigger 20% more often (does not stack with item level 20 benefit).

relics.name: Rejuvenated
relics.desc: Pick another Relic from tier 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5, instead of tier 6.

tierPassives.desc: Rare items are 8x more common.
All Seren spells and prayers are unlocked, so long as you have their spellbook/prayerbook unlocked.

relics.name: Infernal Fire
relics.desc:
Grants you an Avernic Star.
- When in inventory or worn in your pocket slot, all combat styles trigger Death Mark 100% of the time.
This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

relics.name: Naragi Edict
relics.desc:
Grants you the Sliver of Edicts.
- The Sliver can be activated from the inventory for 16.8 seconds.
This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

relics.name: Icyenic Faith
relics.desc:
Grants you the Tome of the Icyene.
When worn:
- The tome provides +50 prayer bonus.
- Gain 0.2% Critical Strike chance per 1 prayer bonus you have.
- Gain 0.2% Base ability damage per 1 prayer bonus you have.
This can be reclaimed from the Sage if lost.

effects.desc: Protection prayers and deflect curses block +50% damage.
Protection prayers and deflect curses act as Soul Split being active.

tierPassives.desc: Rare items are 10x more common.
The 'Advance time' spell can be cast without limit.

blessings.name: Adrenaline Junkie
blessings.desc: Increases your maximum Adrenaline and Adrenaline generation.

effects.desc: Your maximum Adrenaline is increased by +50%.
Adrenaline generation is increased by 50%.

blessings.name: Big Boned
blessings.desc: Increases your maximum Life Points and grants bonus damage based on your maximum Life Points.

effects.desc: Your maximum Life Points are increased by 50%.
All damage you deal gains bonus damage equal to 5% of your maximum Life Points.

blessings.name: Teragard's Aegis
blessings.desc: Gain ability damage based on your Armour and increased Health Regeneration, increased further when wielding a shield or defender.

effects.desc: Your Base Ability Damage is increased by 25% of your total Armour value. This bonus is doubled while wielding a defender and tripled while wielding a shield.
Your Base Health Regeneration is increased by 2.5% of your maximum Life Points. This bonus is doubled while wielding a defender and tripled while wielding a shield.

notes: 1 combat blessing reset. Granted on your first unlock of this tier.

blessings.name: Abyssal Cinders
blessings.desc: Your attacks deal bonus damage and have a chance to unleash an <col=E80404>Inferno of Zamorak</col>.

effects.desc: On-hit: Your attacks deal bonus damage equal to 15% of your Ability Damage.
On hit: Your attacks have a 5% chance to unleash an <col=E80404>Inferno of Zamorak</col>. dealing 100%-200% Ability Damage to your target.

blessings.name: Barkscales
blessings.desc: Convert Armour into damage reduction and periodically unleash a <col=2F995E>Grasp of Guthix</col> after being attacked.

effects.desc: Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of your armour value.
After Barkscales reduces damage 5 times, unleash a <col=2F995E>Grasp of Guthix</col> at your attacker's location.

blessings.name: Striking Light
blessings.desc: Empower your basic attacks, causing them to periodically unleash a <col=3366FF>Light of Saradomin</col>.

effects.desc: Your basic attack damage is increased by 40%.
Your basic attacks unleash a <col=3366FF>Light of Saradomin</col> on your target. 9s cooldown.

blessings.name: Avernic Rampage
blessings.desc: Attacks can trigger Avernic Rampage, temporarily removing Adrenaline costs from abilities.

effects.desc: On-attack: 5% chance to activate Avernic Rampage for 7.2s.

blessings.name: Eternal Sustenance
blessings.desc: Eat freely without consuming food or losing Adrenaline.

effects.desc: Food is no longer consumed when eaten.
You no longer lose Adrenaline when eating.

blessings.name: Steadfast Will
blessings.desc: Empower your defensive abilities with divine blessings.

effects.desc: Empowers the 'Bash', 'Preparation', 'Reflect' and 'Revenge' abilities.

notes: A Nature's runepouch, a reclaimable runepouch which holds 4 types of rune.

blessings.name: Demon's Mark
blessings.desc: Always exploit your target's weakness when attacking.

effects.desc: Your accuracy is always calculated using your target's weakness.

blessings.name: Splash Zone
blessings.desc: Increase the damage of area-of-effect and multi-target attacks.

effects.desc: Area-of-effect and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
Area-of-effect abilities deal 5% more damage per size of the target.

blessings.name: Sacred Fervor
blessings.desc: Greatly reduce your ability cooldowns.

effects.desc: Melee ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
Magic ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
Ranged ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
Necromancy ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.

notes: Ability to choose which rotation is active during the following encounters: Araxxor; Vorago; Barrows: Rise of the Six.
1 combat blessing reset. Granted on your first unlock of this tier.

blessings.name: Havoc Born
blessings.desc: Increase your damage at the cost of survivability.

effects.desc: Your damage is increased by 20%.
Your maximum Life Points are reduced by 25%.
Your Armour value is reduced by 25%.

blessings.name: True Equilibrium
blessings.desc: True strength is only found through balance. For each relic alignment you have chosen of order, chaos, and balance, gain additional stats.

effects.desc: Gain 75 base Ability Damage for each relic alignment you have chosen.

blessings.name: Higher Power
blessings.desc: Gain significantly increased damage by sacrificing damage boosting ultimate abilities.

effects.desc: Your Base Ability Damage is increased by 30%. You lose access to the Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, and Sunshine abilities.

notes: All War's Wares rewards are unlocked.

blessings.name: Unholy Critual
blessings.desc: Gain a suite of Critical Strike benefits.

effects.desc: Gain +15% Critical Strike Chance.
Your Critical Strike Chance is capped at 50%. All excess Critical Strike Chance is converted into Critical Strike Damage at a 1:1 ratio.
On Critical Strike: Unleash an <col=E80404>Inferno of Zamorak</col>.
<col=E80404>Inferno of Zamorak</col> gains +50% Critical Strike Damage.

blessings.name: Tearing Thorns
blessings.desc: Increase the power of your damage over time abilites.

effects.desc: Damage over time abilities last 100% longer.
Every 5th hit from a damage over time ability unleashes a <col=2F995E>Grasp of Guthix</col>.
Your <col=2F995E>Grasp of Guthix</col> deals additional damage equal to 20-30% of your maximum Life Points.

blessings.name: Lord of Light
blessings.desc: Empower your basic attacks to call down devastating Lights of Saradomin.

effects.desc: Basic attacks unleash 5 <col=3366FF>Lights of Saradomin</col> at random tiles near your target, each damaging up to 8 targets within 1 tile. 14.4s cooldown.
<col=3366FF>Lights of Saradomin</col> deal 2% increased damage for each point of Prayer Bonus you have.
<col=3366FF>Lights of Saradomin</col> heal you for 5% of the damage they deal.

blessings.name: Perfidious
blessings.desc: Twist divine and infernal powers to their absolute limits.

effects.desc: Empower's <col=E80404>Inferno of Zamorak</col>, <col=2F995E>Grasp of Guthix</col> and <col=3366FF>Lights of Saradomin</col>.

blessings.name: Envenomed
blessings.desc: Greatly increase your poison damage and ignore poison immunity.

effects.desc: Poison Damage is increased by 50% + an additional 2% per Herblore Level.
Damaging an enemy disables their Poison Immunity for 30s.

blessings.name: Tempered Heart
blessings.desc: Continuously generate Adrenaline in combat.

effects.desc: Generate 6% Adrenaline every 1.2s.

blessings.name: Chaotic Insight
blessings.desc: Master equipment sets, enhancing their set effects.

effects.desc: Each combat equipment item counts as 2 additional pieces towards its set effect.

blessings.name: Power Archive
blessings.desc: Grants an Automaton Control Bot that enhances invention perks.

effects.desc: Stores up to 20 Weapon or Armour Gizmos, granting their effects while wearing augmented equipment. Combat perks in stored Gizmos have their rank doubled, excluding perks that do not benefit from additional ranks.

blessings.name: Genesis Essence
blessings.desc: Ascend your weapons to their ultimate form.

effects.desc: Your equipped weapons are treated as tier 120.

notes: 1 combat blessing reset. Granted on your first unlock of this tier.
